# infoblox_reserved_block (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox ReservedBlock from the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// List specific Reserved Blocks using filters
list "infoblox_reserved_block" "list_reserved_block_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      comment = "Example Reserved Block created through Terraform"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific Reserved Blocks using Tags
list "infoblox_reserved_block" "list_reserved_block_using_tags" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    tag_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List Reserved Blocks with resource details included
list "infoblox_reserved_block" "list_reserved_block_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
  config {
    tag_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to filter results by UDDI tags. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.
